style: Say in an easy-going, encouraging way, like a relaxed sports coach
lines: Six rungs, one scarf to three. Tap Show me to watch the pattern.
This is your practice chart. Follow Read my chart, or tap Show a sample log.
Grab your scarves. Tap Start a try when you're ready.
One minute. Go!
Halfway. Keep going.
Ten seconds.
Time. Set your scarves down and log your best run.
Nice. Log your best run.
Tap plus or minus to set your best run. Then check your cues and tap Save try.
Saved. Start another try, or see your log.
Too short to log. Start a try when you're ready.
Drop. That run is saved. The counter starts again.
Tap your best try in the first session shown.
Now tap your best try in your latest session.
Which sentence matches your chart? Tap one.
Tap a dip: a session lower than the one before.
A dip is part of practice. Keep going and see what comes next.
No tries yet. Start in Ladder, or tap Show a sample log.
Take one slow breath.
Shake out your hands.
Say: pick it up and go.
Get three juggling scarves. Find a space where your arms can swing out in every direction without touching anyone or anything. Start on rung 1, even if it looks easy.
Pick the cue you're best at. Then pick the cue to practice next.
Open Goal. Choose a rung, a best run, a session, and a prediction. Then tap Set goal.
Practice this rung in 2 sessions to read your chart. Or tap Show a sample log.
No dips yet. When one comes, look at what happens next.
Clear every try on this device? This can't be undone. Tap Clear or Keep it.
Rung 1: one scarf. Toss it up and claw it with the same hand.
Pinch, palm down.
Pinch the scarf in its middle, palm facing the floor.
Lift high, let go.
Reach up as high as you can, then let go.
Claw from above.
Reach over the top and grab down, like snatching it from the air.
Rung 1 looks ready. Try rung 2 when you want to.
Rung 2: toss across your body and claw it with the other hand.
Toss across.
Let go on the other side of your body.
Let go up high.
Let go above your head so it floats longer.
Claw with the other hand.
The other hand reaches over the top and grabs down.
Rung 2 looks ready. Try rung 3 when you want to.
Rung 3: two scarves. Throw, throw, catch, catch.
Make an X.
The two scarves cross in front of you.
Toss 2 at the top.
Wait until scarf 1 is at its highest, then toss scarf 2.
First up, first caught.
Claw scarf 1 first, then scarf 2.
Rung 3 looks ready. Try rung 4 when you want to.
Rung 4: three scarves. Just toss them in order and let them fall.
Two in one hand.
Ring and little finger hold one, the fingertips pinch the other.
That hand starts.
The first toss comes from the hand holding two.
Every toss crosses.
Each scarf lands on the other side from where it started.
Rung 4 looks ready. Try rung 5 when you want to.
Rung 5: one full round with three. Three tosses, three catches.
Toss at the top.
Each new toss goes when the last scarf is at its highest.
Claw, then toss.
The hand that just threw is free to claw.
Three up, three caught.
Count the catches: one, two, three.
Rung 5 looks ready. Try rung 6 when you want to.
Rung 6: the cascade. Keep the round going.
Keep the X.
Every toss still crosses.
Toss at the top, every time.
Watch the top of the scarf in the air, not your hands.
Throw first.
A good toss matters more than a catch. Keep tossing.
Rung 6 looks ready. Keep practicing the cascade when you want to.
Thirty seconds left. Keep going.
Tap Ladder to practice again, or explore another card in My log.
Choose a rung, a best run, a session, and a prediction. Then tap Change goal.
